scope: Pinned 84-stamp host-Mesa RTV4 synthetic black stroke, 192x192 at one scale; SVG V8 prototype converted through local sdocx SVG-to-PDF exporter, compared to same native alpha frame. This is not a saved-note, device, or production paint control.
runner_source: conformance/pencil2_v14_svg_pdf_runner.rs; PDF dpi=72; build against this checkout with shared agent target
limitations: SVG prototype and native frame reside in tmp/vector-parity-plan/pen-family-audit and must remain available to reproduce.
PDF reader differences establish neither cause nor behavior in other viewers or scales.
Native alpha is compared to transparent PDF reader output; this does not establish RGB behavior.
No natural Drawing admission, Android, saved-note, arbitrary color, or production parity.
runner_build: Place runner_source in a temporary Cargo package named sdocx-svg-pdf-brush with a path dependency on crates/sdocx and feature pdf; cargo build using the shared agent target and profile settings.

independent_reproduction.result: Native, SVG and PDF hashes and all reported alpha metrics reproduced.
